items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Herbie Hancock said, “We’re in the moment when we play.”

ctx.x: You know the language. So you hear what I’m saying, and you get it. Hopefully some people who might not know the language get it. Because I’m doing it, I mean I’m in the moment. I really am in the moment when I’m doing whatever it is that I do. And I hope they get it. But I’m not trying to exclude them. I’m trying to be accessible. But I’d like to challenge their ears at the same time. I don’t want to be like gee what just happened? I want them to go, “That was interesting, I think.”
Can you expand on that a little bit? Because I’ve heard other people say, Herbie Hancock said, “We’re in the moment when we play.” I’m not sure what that means to everybody.
